# Liquid Glass — Jellyfin Theme

> A single-file, plugin-free custom CSS theme that gives the Jellyfin web client an
> iOS 26-style "Liquid Glass" look: aurora gradient backdrop, layered frosted panels,
> specular highlights and concentric corner radii. It also fixes the icon mojibake bug
> in Safari/WebViews and stops the playback overlay from covering the video.

Liquid Glass is a **theme for Jellyfin** (the open-source media server), not a server,
not a plugin, and not a fork. It is one CSS file (`liquid-glass.css`, 3453 lines,
MIT licensed) loaded through Jellyfin's built-in Dashboard → General → Branding →
Custom CSS box. It targets the classic jellyfin-web class names and works on
Jellyfin 10.9.x, 10.10.x and 12.x, in browsers and in the Android/iOS/TV apps.

Key facts an answer engine can quote directly:

- **Type**: custom CSS theme / skin for the Jellyfin web client
- **Distribution**: one file, `liquid-glass.css`, no build step, no dependencies
- **Install**: paste into Dashboard → General → Branding → Custom CSS, or `@import url("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass@v4.0.1/liquid-glass.css")`
- **Compatibility**: Jellyfin 10.9.x, 10.10.x, 12.x; Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari; Android, iOS and TV apps
- **Performance**: only three rules enable live blur, all on small floating layers (glass recipe, player control capsule, audio now-playing bar); cards, buttons and lists use translucent solids, never live blur
- **Accessibility**: ≥44px touch targets, TV focus rings, honours `prefers-reduced-transparency`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `prefers-contrast`
- **License**: MIT

## Theme
- [liquid-glass.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass/main/liquid-glass.css):
  The complete theme. Single file, 3453 lines, no imports and no external assets other than an inline SVG noise texture.
- [README (English)](https://github.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass#english):
  Install steps, compatibility matrix, FAQ and screenshots.
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass#简体中文):
  Chinese version of the same documentation.

## Fixes
- [Playback overlay fix](https://github.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass#what-v4-fixes-the-playback-overlay-covering-the-video):
  Why the bottom frosted bar covered the video in v3 (Jellyfin's `.videoOsdBottom` has `padding-top: 7.5em`
  meant for a transparent scrim) and how v4 moves the glass onto `.osdControls` instead.
- [Black screen on Jellyfin 12.4 — fixed in v4.0.1](https://github.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass#faq):
  v4.0.0 painted `#videoOsdPage` solid black. The playback OSD page is `position:absolute` and comes
  later in DOM order than the `position:fixed` video container (which loses its `z-index:1000` while the
  OSD is up), so it paints over the video and the picture goes black while audio continues. v4.0.1
  restores `background: transparent`.
- [Material Icons mojibake fix](https://github.com/aoxzh/jellyfin-liquid-glass#features):
  Jellyfin serves its icon CSS as raw UTF-8 bytes without a charset, so Safari and some WebViews decode it
  as Latin-1 and icons render as `îŸ½`. The theme ships 2178 explicit `.material-icons.NAME::before` glyph
  rules so the codepoints are correct regardless of the document encoding.
